_about: Reviewed influence entries that could not be re-keyed on 22 Nov 2026. data/influence_review.json keys each verdict to a hash of the record sentence it judges (tools/build_influence.py). 648 verdicts whose sentence had only been reworded were moved to the new hash. For the ones below the record now says something materially different, or no longer names the funder in that place, so the verdict needs the editor: re-read  (the nearest sentence the record carries for that funder, where there is one), then move the verdict to that sentence, rewrite it, or delete it. Kept entries are still shown in assets/influence.json, carried over by hand from the layer as last built; the next plain rebuild drops them.
